data.title: Five Premier League stars to watch this season
data.description: LONDON - The new Premier League season kicks off on Friday, setting the stage for a galaxy of stars to shine in the 2026-27 campaign.

data.title: China goes rural with data centres in quest to power AI
data.description: GUIAN NEW AREA (CHINA) - In China's hilly Guizhou province, a cluster of European-style buildings complete with clock tower and multi-arched bridge emits a low, permanent hum -- a clue to its unexpected identity as tech giant Huawei's largest data centre.

data.title: Trump pauses 50% tariffs on Canadian goods for three days
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump paused the planned rollout of new tariffs on Canadian goods late Tuesday, after negotiations between both countries that went down to the wire.

data.title: ONE Championship: Chatri wants ‘big’ Tokyo fight for Di Bella after Superlek ACL surgery
data.description: ONE Championship is searching for a new opponent for Jonathan Di Bella after Superlek Kiatmoo9’s torn ACL ruled him out of their flyweight kickboxing title fight in Tokyo.

data.title: AWC launches 416-room Fairmont Bangkok with a focus on luxury MICE and wellness
data.description: AWC has opened Thailand’s first Fairmont hotel in Bangkok after investing more than THB6 billion, targeting international luxury MICE demand

data.title: Humanoid resources: China's robots search for workforce breakthrough
data.description: HANGZHOU (CHINA) - A horde of schoolchildren watched excitedly as a diminutive humanoid tour guide named Wuji welcomed them to a robot school in eastern China, gesticulating theatrically as it described the institute's aspiration to train the mechanical workforce of the future.

data.title: Vietnam police address ex-politician's car crash that killed a teenager
data.description: HANOI — A former Vietnamese politician unintentionally killed a teenager ​in a traffic accident in central Hanoi last year ‌but was exempted from criminal prosecution, a police officer told state television, shedding light for the first time on a case that has fuelled criticism online for months.

data.title: Eastern Economic Corridor expansion plan 'must be transparent'
data.description: <p>Opposition leader Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut has called on Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to ensure transparency over the proposed expansion of the Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC) into Prachin Buri province.</p>

data.title: Consumer protection board ramps up plane seat inquiry
data.description: <p>Prime Minister's Office Minister Supamas Isarabhakdi has ordered the Office of the Consumer Protection Board (OCPB) to broaden its probe into airline overbooking after a passenger was denied boarding despite checking in on time.</p>

data.title: Betagro Supports HYROX Under ‘Betagro, The Better Match’ Fuel Every Move, Fun Every Match
data.description: Bangkok – 18 August 2026 – Betagro Public Company Limited (BTG), a leading integrated food company in Thailand, has boosted its presence in active lifestyle sports with its inaugural HYROX sponsorship. This initiative supports seven athletes at BYD HYROX Bangkok 2026 and reinforces the company’s concept, ‘Betagro, The Better Match,’ which aims to nourish both “athletes” and “audiences” with quality food from Betagro Group.

data.title: GCNT Expo 2026: Shaping Thailand's Sustainable Future in a Fractured World
data.description: The Global Compact Network Thailand (GCNT) , Thailand's largest private-sector sustainability network, has announced the GCNT Expo 2026 . The event will take place from Sept 2 to 4 at True Digital Park, Bangkok , under the theme "From SHOCK To SHIFT: Thailand's Sustainable Transition in a Fractured World."

data.title: US, South Korea cut drills short after Trump criticism
data.description: SEOUL — Annual war games between South Korea and the United States will end around a week earlier than planned, both countries said on Wednesday, after US President Donald Trump ordered the "inappropriate and hostile" drills scaled back.

data.title: New bad debts rise as high costs and weak demand strain Thai firms
data.description: New and re-entry NPLs totalled about THB110 billion in Q2, while SME lending contracted for a 16th straight quarter, according to the BOT.

data.title: Cabinet backs new labour protections
data.description: <p>The cabinet has approved four labour measures aimed at closing legal gaps and expanding protections for seafarers, home-based workers and state enterprise employees following the implementation of the marriage equality law.</p>

data.title: Ernie the easy giant! Meeting the legend left me starstruck
data.description: <p>I met Ernie Els in a private room in the back of Wentworth's iconic club house. I was part of an entourage accompanying the new owner of the famous club. I was still recovering from the excitement of the ultimate flying experience of travelling from Beijing to London on a private jet and then given the VIP treatment on arriving at the famous club.</p>

data.title: New Zealand blocks lawsuits against firms over climate harm
data.description: WELLINGTON - New Zealand has passed hotly contested legislation to block lawsuits that seek to hold companies liable for climate change harm.

data.title: Celebrating Southeast Asia's creative minds
data.description: <p>In a world of rapidly evolving technology, the best ideas still start with people. It takes a special type of creative fire to choose curiosity over fear in the face of change and these talents continue to rise above in pursuit of their next best idea, constantly evolving with the times and the tech that comes along with it.</p>

data.title: New Zealand Education Fair opens soon
data.description: <p>Families are invited to explore study options at the New Zealand Education Fair 2026 at Samyan Mitrtown Hall 2, 5th floor of Samyan Mitrtown, Rama IV Road, on Aug 29 from 11am to 5pm.</p>

data.title: Siam Paragon hosts local brands at 'Capture The New Thai Wave'
data.description: <p>A range of creative products highlighted by innovative concepts and design will be available during "Capture The New Thai Wave" at Gourmet Market in Siam Paragon, Rama I Road, from Friday to Sept 4.</p>

data.title: Henrik Ibsen hounoured by Chula drama programme
data.description: <p>The Department of Dramatic Arts at Chulalongkorn University is commemorating Henrik Ibsen, the father of modern drama, to mark the 120th anniversary of his passing.</p>
